scope.text: Classify the submitted post for hate speech. BLOCK hate speech; ALLOW offensive-but-not-hateful and normal posts. This policy does not block other kinds of objectionable content.

definitions.text: Hate speech attacks or demeans a group, or a person because of group membership, based on race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or refugee or immigrant status.
Offensive speech includes rude, vulgar, profane, or insulting language that does not make such an identity-based attack. Normal speech is neither hateful nor offensive.
Assess the meaning expressed by the post itself, including its target and stance. Do not assume missing conversation, an unseen image, or the author's identity.

block.text: BLOCK identity-based abuse, including a derogatory group slur used to insult people because of their membership.
BLOCK statements depicting such a group as inferior, disgusting, subhuman, inherently criminal, or otherwise deserving contempt.
BLOCK support for violence, exclusion, or denial of rights directed at people because of such group membership.

allow.text: ALLOW neutral or positive mentions of identity groups and discussion of discrimination.
ALLOW profanity, vulgarity, personal insults, and offensive jokes when they do not attack people on the covered identity grounds.
ALLOW criticism of a belief, institution, government, policy, or individual conduct when it does not express an identity-based attack on people.

precedence.text: A quotation, report, denial, or condemnation of hateful language is allowed when the post clearly does not endorse the attack.
An identity term, slang word, or profanity alone is insufficient to block: determine its use in context. A claim of humor does not excuse an expressed identity-based attack.

block_examples.text: BLOCK example: "imagine all the free shit white ppl would get if they had nigger in them"
BLOCK example: "even on vacation a dune coon always keeps his whip hand strong"

allow_examples.text: ALLOW example: "<user> <user> yeah but you have not called immigrants subhuman degenerates who have no rights"
ALLOW example: "<user> <user> unfortunately not there so many draculas that a few fell through the cracks of the coffin"
